title: FACTOID: A New Dataset for Identifying Misinformation Spreaders and Political Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning political bias scores to users based on the partisanship of the news sources they share (from mediabiasfactcheck.com), and evaluating machine learning and graph-based models to classify users as left-wing or right-wing using text embeddings, psycho-linguistic features, and social network interactions.
